normalized_matching_profile.name: Coastal Vue
normalized_matching_profile.description: DescriptionCoastal Vue is a beautiful gulf-side home nestled on the pristine white sands of 30A, situated between Seacrest Beach and Rosemary Beach. Located in the exclusive, family-friendly gated Longue Vue community. It offers a superb location just one block from the shops and dining options of Seacrest Beach and within a short walk to Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach. This Seacrest rental has everything you need for a high-end beach retreat. Guests will appreciate the private, gated road and convenient beach access, located only 100 steps away. Those searching for 30A vacation rentals featuring a private pool will be delighted with this option. Cap off your day with spectacular Gulf of Mexico sunsets viewed from the fourth-floor cocktail porch. The property features five bedrooms and four bathrooms and can accommodate up to fourteen guests. All attractions are within walking distance, and complimentary adult bikes are included for guests to make the most of their stay.Home Highlights:Beach Access: Just 100 steps away (approximately a 1-minute walk)Private Beach Services: Offered through the Longue Vue Community private accessParking: Room for up to four vehicles in the drivewayDining: Table seating for 8-10 guests, plus bar seating for fourCoffee Maker: IncludedOutdoor Grill: Gas grill with propane providedPrivate Heated Pool: Available for guest use. Note: Pool heating requires 24 hours to reach a temperature of 83-85°F. Please arrange in advance by contacting Reservations. (Pool heat may be added for $45/day plus tax)Sleeping Arrangements + Home Layout:Sleeps: 14 guests5 Bedrooms / 4 BathroomsFirst Floor:Bedroom 1: Queen bed with shared bathroom (shower/tub combination)Bedroom 2: Two twin bunk beds(4 twin beds total) with shared bathroom (shower/tub combination)Bedroom 3: King bed with private bathroom (shower)Second Floor:Bedroom 4: Queen sized bedLiving room with pullout couch, dining, full bathroom and kitchen area connects to an outside balcony.Third Floor:Bedroom 5 (Master Suite): King bed with private bathroom with double vanity and large glass enclosed shower. Complete with a private balcony.Fourth Floor:Eagles nest/balcony with seating that overlooks the neighborhood with spectacular gulf views.Amenities:4 adult bikesElevate Your Beach Experience - Reserve Your Beach Comforts EarlyEmbrace the luxury of hassle-free beach days at Longue Vue, where we prioritize your seaside relaxation. From March 1st through October 31st, Longue Vue Beach Services offers exclusive, premium beach chair and umbrella setups. Personal chairs and umbrellas are kindly not permitted during these times to ensure a seamless and elegant beachfront aesthetic. Rest assured, Longue Vue Beach Services guarantees the most competitive rates exclusively for homeowners, personal guests, and renters. For those enchanting evenings by the shore, inquire about organizing a beach bonfire through our community-approved vendor - a perfect way to create unforgettable memories under the stars.Community Guidelines to Enhance Your StayPlease note, the Longue Vue community maintains a serene and orderly environment by not permitting golf carts. This policy ensures the tranquility and safety of all our guests and residents, allowing everyone to enjoy the beauty of Longue Vue to the fullest.
